summary: Stage 3A round 1 at 444a695e2 passes. cube.py is a bounded application-owned callable with one object per run, stream-identity-keyed banks (at most two), disjoint float32 sum/uint64 count banks per stream, a single-thread count kernel and a one-thread-per-pixel accumulate kernel that serializes repeated bin IDs within a callback, so no accumulation race exists. Bin assignment uses a constructor-time timestamp-to-ordinal map (ordinal % 29 over 30 bins) that is independent of callback, stream or BD order; unknown, repeated, empty or post-finish identities are rejected. Banks are retained in self.banks before asynchronous zero-fill, and images, errors, bins, accepted, the host bin array and both bank arrays are registered through the batch keepalive before the H2D and both launches. Step labels are recorded, never reset, and never affect sums. finish refuses closed or incomplete cubes, joins every bank stream, exports one bin at a time and merges in float64; repeated finish returns the same object without re-export; close joins and clears banks idempotently and serves aborts. Capture reuses Stage 2 adapter/calibration unchanged (hashes equal Stage 2 commit-provenance), publishes only sim10.errors and keeps full images batch-owned, so no full-image D2H occurs. The acceptance driver independently traverses the fixture, expands seeds and applies CPU-v3 calibration with frozen constants, accumulates float64 sums and exact counts, and enforces gamma_n*sum|x|+1e-5 with u=2^-24 per bin, which is a valid bound for two float32 recursive partial sums merged in float64. Evidence: tiny02/tail01/pilot01 reports pass with 10/3/1000 events, exact counts (pilot 14x35 + 15x34 + empty bin 29 = 1000), both streams exercised (6/4, 2/1, 501/499), max bound ratio 0.178 on the pilot, 503,316,480 pixels compared, controlled GPU tests pass in all three jobs, two host tests pass, report digests/sizes match index.json and validation-summary, code_sha256 blocks in all reports match commit-provenance for the reviewed SHA, and generation/verification digests and runtime module hashes match the accepted Stage 2 summary. README numbers match the reports. One low non-blocking finding: the runtime third-stream rejection path is untested. No core, data, DB, MPI/GDS, lifecycle-hook or scientific-cube claims are made.
checks: Read scope.md, cube.py, acceptance.py, test_cube.py, run_gpu.sbatch, README.md, validation-summary.json, status.json, unit-tests.log and review-01/context.md in notes/mfx_expand10_stage3a_20261105.
Read all five evidence copies under build/stage3a-review-evidence (index.json, commit-provenance.json, tiny02.json, tail01.json, pilot01.json) in full.

Race freedom: accept_events runs on one thread (cube.py:16) and increments counts per accepted event sequentially; accumulate assigns one thread per pixel via grid-stride and iterates events in order (cube.py:27-30), so repeated bins within a callback serialize; banks are per stream object so streams never share destinations.

Exact counts and malformed panel rejection: an event is accepted only if all 32 error words are zero (cube.py:19); accepted flag gates both counts and sums; controlled test rejects event 5 with a single panel error and native driver requires zero sim10.errors per event (acceptance.py:71).

Ordering/lifetime: keepalive(images, errors, bins, accepted, host_bins, bank.sums, bank.counts) precedes bins.set and both kernel launches (cube.py:120-128); bank appended to self.banks before fill(0) (cube.py:102-104); all work on the supplied stream inside with stream; ProducerContext.keepalive is variadic (gpu_producer.py:140).

Stream identity: _bank matches on object identity (cube.py:97); EventPool creates n persistent non_blocking Stream objects per run (gpu_stream.py:81) and dispatch_task passes self._streams[slot] (gpu_stream.py:180,232), so at most n_gpu_streams=2 banks per run.

Global mapping: ordinal dict built from the frozen schedule in __init__ (cube.py:76); _identify maps timestamps to ordinal % active_bins (cube.py:93) and rejects unknown, repeated, seen, empty inputs and any non-open phase; CPU reference bins i%29 over the same schedule order (acceptance.py:70,94,99).
No step-label reset: step_label only recorded in bank.step_labels (cube.py:131); sums never keyed on step_generation; controlled test asserts both banks retain {10,20}.

Completion/abort: finish refuses non-open or incomplete (len(seen)!=len(ordinal)) cubes, synchronizes every bank stream, exports one bin at a time into float64 host arrays, is idempotent via phase 'finished' (cube.py:151-167); close synchronizes then clears banks idempotently (cube.py:169-175); acceptance collects bank info before close and calls close in finally.

Capture: intercepts publish, keeps every array alive via batch.keepalive, publishes only sim10.errors (cube.py:56-60); Sample10 and JungfrauCalibration.calibrate(publish=True) route through it, so jungfrau.calib and sim10.expanded are never published or copied to host.

CPU bound: eps=2^-24, gamma=n*eps/(1-n*eps), bound=gamma*sum|x|+1e-5, finite check, empty bins must be exactly zero (acceptance.py:103-111); valid for float32 recursive sums over two stream partials merged in float64 since gamma_{n1}A1+gamma_{n2}A2 <= gamma_n(A1+A2).
State cap: per-stream bytes 30*(16777216*4+8)=2,013,266,160; two banks 4,026,532,320 <= 5 GiB; acceptance also requires persistent_bytes_total <= 5<<30 and exactly two banks (acceptance.py:115-116).

Evidence binding: index.json sha256/bytes equal validation-summary report entries (6faba181/14504, ca9aae88/29167, e97b4346/14415); commit-provenance implementation_commit equals reviewed SHA and its nine file digests equal code_sha256 in all three reports; gpu_accept.py, adapter.py, runtime.sh and jungfrau_calibration.py digests equal Stage 2 commit-provenance (Stage 2 reused unchanged).

Fixture binding: generation_sha256 per report (0d9a6aab tiny, bf57932e tail, f700a4cd pilot) and stage2_cpu_verification digests equal the accepted Stage 2 validation-summary; acceptance.py:50-52 enforces this at runtime; runtime psana module hashes identical to Stage 2.

Results: events_completed 10/3/1000; counts tiny ten 1s, tail three 1s, pilot 14x35 then 15x34 then 0 (sum 1000, bin 29 empty); bank_event_counts 6/4, 2/1, 501/499; pilot bank index blocks consistent with callback_batch_sizes (e.g. 5,2 at indices 100-106); max_abs_error 0/0/1.1875 and max_bound_ratio 0/0/0.17813; all_counts_exact and all_cube_pixels_within_bound true; compared_cube_pixels 503,316,480; controlled_gpu_tests pass in all three jobs with step_retention {10,20} on both banks.

Host tests: unit-tests.log shows 2 tests OK; test_global_identity checks ordinal mapping [1,0,0] and four rejection cases; test_configuration_budget checks duplicate timestamps, active_bins>30, state cap and max_streams>2.

README table and memory numbers (2,013,266,160; 4,026,532,320; 6,064,670,208; 1.1875; 0.178131; 503,316,480) match the reports; README and scope make no managed lifecycle, native multi-step, MPI/GDS, 35 kHz or scientific-cube claims.
